name: Nightly Workflow

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./core/...

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: failure()
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          junit_files: '**/test-results.xml'

  ci-integration:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run fast gates
        run: |
          # Add commands to run the first 9 production gates here
          echo "Running fast gates..."

      - name: Run full gate suite
        if: success()
        run: |
          # Add commands to run the remaining 8 production gates here
          echo "Running full gate suite..."

      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        with:
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          message: "CI Integration Job ${job.status}"

  cleanup:
    needs: ci-integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Clean up
        run: |
          # Add cleanup commands here
          echo "Cleaning up..."
